Every stress statement concerns other languages: 'Stress in Hoamoal languages is always penultimate; if a suffix or particle is added to the word the stress shifts accordingly. In Asilulu this is not the case. The stress falls on the penultimate syllable of the root word' (pp. 82-83); Kaibobo 'e when stressed, o when unstressed' (fn. 87-88); Tehoru, Buru. Sile…
